verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback widget lets a user mark up a screenshot of the screen they are looking at and point at the element, attaching page metadata so the model fixes the right thing. A submission can then become an intention whose agent reads it and proposes tasks, so a marked-up screenshot can reach the agent indirectly. However, nothing shows a developer attaching a screenshot or mockup directly to a task or intention, or that the image is carried into the agent's task contract. Missing for 10: direct image/mockup attachment on tasks for developers, evidence that attached visuals pass through to the executing agent, support for mockups (not just live-screen captures), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
